status: DRAFT / NOT FROZEN / ACQUISITION NOT AUTHORIZED
scope: Outcome-blind PUBLIC BTCUSDC Spot acquisition only; no fill or profitability claim
blocking_prerequisites: Collector permits only engineering sessions <=30 seconds; no sustained prospective entry point exists
Persisted ingress/backlog occupancy is unknown; soak-only WS frame sampling is not a persisted guard
Existing delay guard excludes raw/ack fsync and live replay; full causal availability and local backlog guards must be implemented and tested
Prospective 15-minute lifecycle, periodic clock/metadata refresh, bounded memory and sustained throughput are unverified
Atomic session seals, failure-aware eligibility, fixed scheduler, disk reserve and all-history dataset seal are not implemented

order: Commit and tag final protocol plus source/config/runtime bindings
Select and bind future UTC cutoff strictly after freeze
cutoff_design.session_start_rule: First control/receipt UTC strictly greater than cutoff; no pre-cutoff bootstrap or straddle
cutoff_design.engineering_sessions: Never eligible regardless of date or certification
cutoff_design.cutoff_binding: Immutable cutoff record binds frozen protocol SHA, commit/tag and exact UTC timestamp before first prospective session

classifications.FAILED: Abrupt termination, Ctrl+C/cancellation, unclosed resources, journal/write/fsync/ack failure, truncation, malformed provenance/hash/replay, missing/partial final seal; preserve available bytes and failure history
classifications.INELIGIBLE: Successfully closed, structurally verifiable session failing any completeness/continuity/clock/backlog/metadata/cutoff/scope gate; recovery cannot clear latch
classifications.ELIGIBLE: Authorized prospective CLOSED session with valid immutable seal and every gate true
classifications.precedence: FAILED before INELIGIBLE before ELIGIBLE; failure sidecar/controller history defeats raw-only replay certification
classifications.active: PENDING, never research input; unfinished at endpoint becomes FAILED
classifications.repair: Never rewrite, trim, delete, overwrite or promote failed history; restart with new identity/directory only

eligibility_gates: Explicit prospective scope and authorization; not engineering
CLOSED; successful resource closure; final immutable seal committed last; no failure sidecar/controller latch
Every event has exact-line SHA-bound acknowledgement and valid completion provenance
Raw replay twice; canonical bytes identical and seal-bound
Valid snapshot/update bridge and synchronized depth
Continuous depth/trade/aggregate IDs and aggregate ranges; complete Decimal reconciliation of all recorded trades/aggregates
Continuous ingestion ordinals, stream indices, connection epochs and clock namespace
No historical gap, disconnect, outage, resync, drop, malformed event or unresolved reconciliation
Valid UTC/monotonic provenance; no regression/discontinuity over existing 10000us tolerance
Dated metadata and clock mapping refreshed at most every 30s; existing 60s freshness limits retained
Full receive-through-persistence-and-live-replay availability delay <=1000000us; persisted local WS frame occupancy <=128; no known application drops; implement and test before freeze
Disk reserve maintained; closure and durability steps successful

capture_edges.first_trade_id: Observed baseline only; no preceding coverage inferred
capture_edges.partial_first_last_aggregate: Reject whole session; no trimming, grace-fill, outcome backfill or selective prefix
capture_edges.late_arrival_at_close: Fixed capture endpoint, deterministic owned-worker shutdown; no outcome-selected drain; unresolved edge rejects whole session
capture_edges.eligible_coverage: Elapsed monotonic time from first valid BOOK_SYNC_ESTABLISHED to expected endpoint DISCONNECTED; no pre-bridge credit; retain raw bootstrap unchanged
capture_edges.endpoint: 900s from first session control; no extension to reconcile edges

storage.rotation: One immutable directory per fixed session; paired events.jsonl and persistence.acks.jsonl; no independent intra-session rotation
storage.fsync: Flush/fsync each raw event before SHA-bound ack, then flush/fsync ack; no batching
storage.headroom_rationale: Operational planning assumption, not a confidence bound or rate guarantee
storage.reserve_rationale: 10GiB exceeds 40 planned session budgets, providing closure/failure-evidence headroom
storage.disk_preflight: Free >=10GiB plus one 4x-rate session budget; separate same-volume write/fsync/close and atomic-publication probe
storage.runtime_guard: Check reserve before each append; breach stops acquisition and attempts FAILED closure; no auto-delete or same-slot restart
storage.atomic_seal: Close tasks/journals; fsync; hash exact bytes; replay twice; write/fsync exclusive temporary seal on same volume; publish final marker atomically without overwrite; verify published bytes
storage.durability: Record filesystem and actual flush/atomic-publication capability; no invented directory-fsync/power-loss guarantee; missing/torn marker is FAILED
storage.compression: Only post-seal, lossless, archive SHA plus original file SHAs; decompressed bytes match exactly; retain originals; no automatic deletion

readiness_target.rationale: Two independent boots on each of three dates is a minimal repeated operational check. Six 15-minute windows give 90 minutes gross; one-hour synchronized coverage rejects predominantly unsynced captures. 40% prevents date domination. No statistical power, fill, economic or regime-coverage claim.
readiness_target.all_sessions: All passing sessions count; no selective removal to satisfy concentration
readiness_target.not_v10_reuse: Engineering rationale only, not V10's 24h/8/4 thresholds

stopping_rule.slot_rule: Every slot strictly after cutoff whose full window plus 30s cleanup allowance fits before horizon; no catch-up, same-slot retry or discretionary replacement
stopping_rule.end: First completed-session readiness PASS, else cutoff+72h; no observations beyond endpoint to improve reconciliation
stopping_rule.expired: INSUFFICIENT_ACQUISITION; seal all history and stop; no discretionary extension
stopping_rule.rationale: Three daily operational repetitions fit within 72h; endpoint cannot depend on research outcomes

dataset_seal_schema.status: Future schema proposal only; no dataset seal created
dataset_seal_schema.rules: Include all ELIGIBLE/INELIGIBLE/FAILED history and missed slots. Null absent hashes with reasons; never omit failures. Body SHA excludes its own digest; later evaluation preregistration binds final seal bytes. Atomic publication without overwrite before maker-plan evaluation.

outcome_blind_dashboard.enforcement: Separate acquisition component without MakerPlan, maker_replay, score or economic entry points; restricted readout; no exploratory raw access
